item.title: Meta approaches SC against NCLAT order upholding Rs 213 crore CCI penalty on WhatsApp
item.description: New Delhi: Meta Platforms and WhatsApp have approached the Supreme Court challenging the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal’s (NCLAT) decision that upheld a Rs 213.14 crore penalty imposed by the Competition Commission of India (CCI) over WhatsApp’s 2021 privacy policy update, according to Bar and Bench. item.title: NYF Advertising Awards opens 2026 entries with Grey New York’s ‘No BS’ campaign
item.description: New Delhi: New York Festivals Advertising Awards has opened entries for its 2026 edition, rolling out a new “No BS” campaign created by Grey New York that takes a satirical swipe at awards-chasing culture. The campaign, titled “Bobby Lobby”, introduces a self-styled “jury whisperer” who claims he can deliver insider influence, secret shortcuts and guaranteed wins, poking fun at the idea that awards can be gamed rather than earned. item.title: How Shubman Gill reflects India’s aspirational growth in Tata Capital’s ‘Zidd Tarakki Ki’ campaign
item.description: New Delhi: Tata Capital has rolled out a new brand campaign titled ‘Zidd Tarakki Ki’, featuring Indian cricketer and brand ambassador Shubman Gill. The campaign draws on narratives of personal determination and progress, reflecting what the company describes as India’s broader aspirational growth story. item.title: Vritti Solutions launches IT services division as it expands operations in the UAE
item.description: New Delhi: India-based enterprise technology solutions provider Vritti Solutions has launched a dedicated IT Services Division, marking an expansion of its operations in the UAE and a broader shift towards end-to-end technology services. item.title: ASCI Academy launches e-learning course on ethical UI and UX design
item.description: New Delhi: ASCI Academy, the training arm of the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI), has launched an e-learning course titled Ethical UI and UX Designs: Building Consumer Trust, developed in collaboration with Hindustan Unilever (HUL). item.title: Kotak family office makes maiden foreign investment; acquires US snack brand Go Raw
item.description: New Delhi: USK Capital, the family office of billionaire banker Uday Kotak, has acquired a majority stake in US-based snacking brand Go Raw, marking its maiden foreign investment through the overseas direct investment (ODI) route. The family office acquired a majority interest in Freeland Foods LLC, the owner of the Go Raw brand, through one of its operating entities, according to a company statement. item.title: Spalba appoints Deepanshu Gupta as CEO
item.description: New Delhi: Spalba, an event-tech platform connecting brands and agencies with venues and experiential services, has named Deepanshu Gupta as its Chief Executive Officer. Gupta brings a background in live events, experiential marketing, and technology-driven business transformation. item.title: CNN-News18 launches ‘Ballot Maximum City’ programme to cover Mumbai’s BMC elections
item.description: New Delhi: As the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) prepares for elections on January 15, CNN-News18 has announced a special election coverage programme titled ‘Ballot Maximum City’. The initiative brings together the channel’s anchors, editors, and reporters to provide detailed reporting on one of the city’s most significant civic polls.
